# Component index

Find a component by what you need, not by its name. Each row gives the component, what it is, the catalog
sample to copy and what it replaces. If a need is not here, check `catalog/` before building one in an app.

## Screens and scaffolds

| Need | Component | What it is | Sample | Replaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| apply the app theme to a tree of content | `BingeExpressiveTheme` | The app theme: the colour, type, shape and motion settings every component here reads, around content | — | — |
| ask one yes-or-no question on a whole screen | `DecisionScreen` | A whole screen that asks one question before the app goes on, such as whether to share usage data: a hero plate, the copy, the points the choice rests on, and the two answers | `DecisionScreenSample` | a hand-built consent or opt-in screen |
| build a detail page under a full-bleed hero | `HeroDetailScreen` | A detail page under a hero: the hero runs full-bleed to the top of the window, a bar fades in over it as the page scrolls past it, and content follows in one scroll | `HeroDetailScreenSample` | a hand-built scaffold with a hero and fading bar |
| build a form or editor screen with its commit action | `FormScreen` | A form or an editor: the fields in a scrolling column under BingeScreenScaffold's bar, lifted by the keyboard rather than covered by it, with its commit in the bar or pinned under the form | `FormScreenSample` | a hand-built scaffold with a scrolling form and save button |
| build a long lazy detail page under a hero | `HeroDetailLazyScreen` | HeroDetailScreen for a long page that stays lazy: content adds items after the hero item, and the bar fades on how far the hero has scrolled out of listState. verticalArrangement, horizontalAlignment and contentPadding are the list's own, and apply to the hero item too: a spacing between every row, rows capped and centred on a wide window, a gap under the last one | `HeroDetailLazyScreenSample` | a hand-built LazyColumn page with a hero item and fading bar |
| build a multi-step setup or onboarding screen | `StepFlowScreen` | A multi-step flow on a phone, foldable or tablet: the default screen chrome at the top (a transparent bar that scrims in as the step passes under it), the step read-out under the bar, the step below, and its commit in a footer pinned under it | `StepFlowScreenSample` | a hand-built stepper with a pinned footer |
| explain what a page is for under its title | `PageIntro` | The sentence under a page's title that says what the page is for | `PageIntroSample` | a hand-built body Text under a page title |
| frame a screen with a top bar, scrolling body and snackbar host | `BingeScreenScaffold` | The frame a phone, foldable or tablet screen with a top bar shares: a transparent bar over a body that scrolls under it, a snackbar host, and an optional pinned bottomBar | `BingeScreenScaffoldSample` | a hand-built Scaffold with a transparent scrolling top bar |
| keep a full-width screen to a readable column on tablets | `CenteredContent` | Caps content at the standard reading width (640dp) and centres it, so a full-width scrolling screen shows a tidy centred column on a tablet/foldable | `CenteredContentSample` | a hand-built Box with a max-width and centred alignment |
| measure the width of a pane in a list-detail layout | `PaneContent` | Measures the pane it sits in and tells content its real width and which edge it shares with a neighbouring pane | `PaneContentDetailScaffoldSample` | a hand-built BoxWithConstraints that publishes its width |
| place a scaffold body with the standard screen padding | `ScreenBody` | The common body of a BingeScreenScaffold: a full-size box placed by screenOuterPadding, handing content the screenInnerPadding that belongs inside its scroll, or around a state that does not scroll | — | hand-computed screen padding around a body |
| preview a screen under real-sized system bars | `PreviewSystemBarInsets` | Renders content under a real-sized status bar and navigation bar, so a screenshot frame exercises the padding a screen reserves from WindowInsets.statusBars / navigationBars — which the preview renderer otherwise reports as zero | — | — |
| show a list split by filter chips, one page per filter | `FilteredListScreen` | A list split by filters: BingeScreenScaffold with a row of filter chips under its bar, one page per filter, swiped or tapped between | `FilteredListScreenSample` | a hand-built scaffold with chips over a pager |
| show the content of a decision as one page of a flow | `DecisionBody` | The decision's content and nothing around it: the optional hero plate, the copy and the points card, stacked | `DecisionBodyInStepFlowSample` | a hand-built hero, copy and points column |
| show the heading block of a decision step | `DecisionHeading` | A decision's kicker, title, subtitle and note, as DecisionScreen and DecisionBody head theirs | — | a hand-built kicker, title and subtitle stack |
| show the title block that opens a flow step | `StepHeading` | The kicker, title and subtitle a step opens with | — | a hand-built kicker, title and subtitle stack |
| wrap a preview or screenshot frame in the theme | `ScreenshotTheme` | Theme wrapper for previews and Compose screenshot tests | — | — |

| show a top bar on a sheet that fills the screen | `BingeSheetTopBar` | The bar a docking BingeBottomSheet shows once it fills the screen (see BingeSheetDockingHeader): close leading, a title with an optional subtitle, and actions | — | a hand-built Row of close button, title and actions |
| switch between different views by tab or swipe | `BingeTabbedPager` | BingeTabRow wired to a HorizontalPager, so tapping a tab and swiping a page stay in sync — both move the selection | `BingeTabbedPagerSample` | a hand-built tab row wired to a HorizontalPager |
| switch between different views with a tab strip | `BingeTabRow` | The tab strip on its own: a scrollable row of text tabs with the active indicator | `BingeTabRowSample` | a raw ScrollableTabRow |

| ask for a name to create a new list | `CreateListDialog` | Dialog for naming and creating a new list | — | a hand-built AlertDialog with a text field |

| draw a task sheet page as the side sheet shows it, for a frame or test | `BingeTaskSheetPanel` | A task sheet's resting panel: the page at the top of pages under a Back bar once there is more than one, inside the side sheet's chrome and clear of the system bars and the keyboard | — | — |

| frame a single-choice sheet body in a preview or inside your own sheet | `BingeChoiceSheetContent` | A BingeChoiceSheet's body without its modal window, as the sheet looks at rest: the drag handle and title over the radio rows, sectioned as the sheet sections them | — | — |
| give a docking sheet a title with subtitle, actions and caption | `BingeSheetHeader` | The header block a docking list sheet shows while it floats: the title with an optional subtitle under it, actions at the end, and an optional caption across the full width below | — | a hand-built Row of title text and action buttons at the top of a sheet |
| keep a drag handle on a sheet step that has no header | `BingeSheetStepHandle` | The drag handle for a step of a docking sheet that has no docking header of its own (a name, a typed path): the handle, which docks into a bar titled title if the sheet is pulled to full height | — | — |
| keep a task sheet page clear of the top edge | `TaskSheetTopClearance` | The space a task sheet's first row keeps from the top edge | — | a hand-built top spacer in a sheet page |
| open a sheet that is a bottom sheet on phones and a side sheet on wide windows | `BingeAdaptiveSheet` | One sheet that picks its form from the window, so a list-detail layout does not get a bottom sheet over both panes | — | choosing between a bottom sheet and a side sheet by hand |
| pick a month and year | `MonthYearPickerDialog` | A month and/or year picker in a dialog, for a bound that is a period rather than a day. mode says which parts to ask for; onConfirm gets a MonthYearSelection with every asked part set and the others null. title is the caller's copy, since only it knows what is being picked | — | a hand-built dialog with month and year lists |
| pick one value from a long list | `BingeChoiceSheet` | A pick of one value from a list | — | a hand-built LazyColumn of radio rows in a sheet |
| pick several values from a list and apply them together | `BingeMultiChoiceSheet` | A pick of any number of values from a list | — | a hand-built LazyColumn of checkbox rows in a sheet |
| place a sheet page primary action so it pins in a side sheet | `BingeSheetFooter` | A slot for a sheet page's primary action, pinned in the side sheet and drawn in place elsewhere | — | a hand-built pinned footer in a side sheet |
| preview a task sheet without its modal window | `TaskSheetPreviewFrame` | A task sheet's resting chrome as the window shows it, without the modal window around it, which does not capture: the side sheet's panel at the expanded width, with the clearance a page keeps there, and a bottom sheet's top below it | — | — |
| render a confirm dialog body in a screenshot frame | `BingeConfirmDialogContent` | Stateless body of BingeConfirmDialog, split out so screenshot tests can render the dialog's visible content directly — the modal AlertDialog window itself does not capture in previews | — | — |
| render a message dialog body in a screenshot frame | `BingeMessageDialogContent` | Stateless body of BingeMessageDialog, apart from the modal window, so a screenshot can render it | — | — |
| show a modal panel on the end edge of a wide window | `BingeModalSideSheet` | A modal side sheet: the tablet/foldable analogue of BingeBottomSheet, anchoring a full-height panel to the end edge instead of the bottom | — | a hand-built end-aligned panel over a scrim |
| show a sheet header that becomes a top bar when the sheet fills the screen | `BingeSheetDockingHeader` | The top of a docking sheet: the drag handle over header while the sheet floats, crossfading to dockedTopBar as it docks under the status bar | — | a hand-built crossfade between a handle and a top bar |
| show content in a modal bottom sheet | `BingeBottomSheet` | Wraps ModalBottomSheet with the binge defaults: surfaceContainerHigh container, onSurface content, expressive corner radius, and skipPartiallyExpanded = true | — | a raw ModalBottomSheet with its colours and shape set by hand |
| tell the user why something failed with one acknowledge button | `BingeMessageDialog` | A dialog that tells the user why something failed and what they can do about it: a title saying what happened, a message with the cause and the next step, and one text button that acknowledges it | — | a raw AlertDialog with a single button |
